title: Four Fields
description: Harvest corn, potatoes, tomatoes, and strawberries across four timed plots in a warm storybook miniature farm.

prompt.objective: Build a compact four-stage harvesting game with rising time pressure.

mintAssets.brief: A farmstead, four crop families, friendly animals, a farmer, and a scythe.
Idle, walk, harvest, reap, and victory motions for the farmer.
Country music, farm ambience, harvest, timer, victory, and UI sounds.

experience: Clear four crop plots before their timers expire.
Restart after a timeout and celebrate a full clear.
prompt.visualDirection: Warm miniature farm with rounded forms, morning light, and honey-wood UI.

thumbnail.alt: A warm storybook miniature farm with a barn, farmhouse, fenced fields, hay bales, and a water trough.
